page_topic_one_liner: Matrix UGC / creator network marketing — industrial short-video pipeline, flat fee + commission + whitelisting for AI products
differentiator_vs_generic: 3×3 phone matrix of amateur vertical clips (NOT polished brand ads or single influencer hero). Stack of payment layers ($/clip, commission %, whitelisting boost arrow). Distinct from creator-program portal or affiliate dashboard.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): 3×3 grid of vertical phone screens showing amateur UGC clips — review face-cam, unboxing hands, quick tutorial — raw TikTok/Reels feel, blurred usernames
Secondary: three stacked torn-paper payment chips — flat fee $35–500, 30% commission badge, whitelisting megaphone boost icon
Tertiary: pipeline arrow showing 100 clips → 1 winner → redeploy to 100 accounts loop
anti_patterns: Single polished KOL portrait as hero
Affiliate dashboard referral link UI (that's affiliate article)
Generic billboard or TV commercial aesthetic
